proposal.summary: An information disclosure issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1 allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

AV.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

PR.quote: Owners can now only write the key, not read it.

C.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch affected versions to restrict access to the Public Key.
